scope.target: Full observable functionality of the pinned public upstream contracts, independently implemented
boundaries: No copied GPL Serena application code
Adapter declarations are not live server certification
Uninspectable hosted and proprietary implementations require explicit independent functional equivalents and honest availability
No inherited upstream performance or correctness claims

capabilities.name: Structural source graph and deterministic default
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Present: immutable multilingual graphs with directed observations and exact bytes. Neither static implementation proves complete runtime behavior.

capabilities.name: Grammar breadth
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Most languages present; .hh and .bb extension handling missing. A grammar count is not construct parity.

capabilities.name: Vue embedded scripts
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing: native .vue is text. Upstream shifts every script block back to parent coordinates, disambiguates duplicate symbol IDs, and supports multiple scripts. Svelte/Astro are explicitly not implemented upstream.

capabilities.name: Language-specific symbols
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Partial: Yoke generic symbol handling misses many declarations, annotations, overloads, extension receivers, R S3/S4/R6 registration methods and mixin list methods.

capabilities.name: Typed receiver candidates
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing: Yoke resolves exact labels or unique same-file/global bare names. Trail syntax-local constructors, annotations, this/self/Go receivers and field typing provide scoped receiver candidates; still not universal compiler binding.

capabilities.name: Import/alias/module resolution
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Partial: Yoke handles some relative file imports. Named imports, alias rebinding, import-qualified member selection, reexports and module/package binding need dedicated implementation.

capabilities.name: Non-call references
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing generally: Yoke lacks general identifier reference extraction. Contract-specific reference hints are separate.

capabilities.name: Extends versus implements
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Partial: Yoke uses combined inherits observations rather than consistently retaining extends/implements contracts.

capabilities.name: Semantic call enrichment
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing: Yoke supports semantic navigation/rename but no prepareCallHierarchy/outgoingCalls/incomingCalls or source-bound semantic call graph import. Upstream selects Rust, clangd, gopls, pyright or TS server.

capabilities.name: Fresh queries, immutable history, caches
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Present with stronger strict snapshots. Missing drift-only report, cheap opt-in metadata freshness mode and explicit historical no-refresh convenience. Whole-agent performance claims require a paired campaign.

capabilities.name: Working-tree/index scopes
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Partial: source protects links/secrets/size and uses Git ignore. Missing explicit only-dir/include-dir and opt-in persisted initialized-submodule/nested-repo boundaries; preserve host authority and protected roots.

capabilities.name: Parent worktree cache seeding
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing convenience: load verified cache from parent checkout and refresh current worktree. Never bypass snapshot identity or copy source-state authority unchecked.

capabilities.name: Task-word/body retrieval
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Partial: Yoke symbol FTS indexes name/signature, not function bodies. Trail BM25, token coverage, file fusion, personalized PageRank and test de-ranking are inspectable ranking features, not quality guarantees.

capabilities.name: Balanced monorepo scopes
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing: markers plus pnpm/package workspaces, per-scope scoring/fusion prevent largest subproject overwhelming smaller scopes. Current Yoke path filtering is substring, not segment-aware.

capabilities.name: Multi-repo folder federation
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing local workspace lifecycle: children get independent caches and prefixed result scopes. Yoke remote scoped source federation already exists but is a different workflow.

capabilities.name: File API / skeleton
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Partial: Yoke outline returns at most200 all-kind entities by substring path; signatures are first-line clipped240characters. Exact-file, multiline, body-free and paged file API is needed.

capabilities.name: Exhaustive regex grouped by symbol
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Partial: Yoke literal/regex paging exists with exact bytes. Missing ignore-case field, innermost-symbol grouping, incoming-edge coupling rank and total searched-coverage accounting.

capabilities.name: Name-based caller tracing / closure
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Partial: Yoke trace starts from entity IDs and max depth8/maxVisited1000. Add qualified-name/file lookup and budgeted closure with explicit truncation.

capabilities.name: Repo map and hubs
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing directory/scoped orientation report; analytics/PageRank exist but do not supply this view.

capabilities.name: Passive linked Markdown context cache
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing: Yoke exports JSON/GraphML/HTML but not linked per-node/file Markdown cards preserving human note sections.

capabilities.name: Optional deep meaning build
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Partial: Yoke own providers produce selected source-bound summaries. Missing batched file summaries, architecture concepts/relations, exact source crux selection, per-body cache and pending/ready/stale coverage report. Source-bound neural inference is not correctness proof.

capabilities.name: Native OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible providers
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Partial: Yoke general executable provider and Ollama are present; ready-to-use reviewed host-credential HTTP provider adapters/model catalog could replace upstream convenience. No automatic model call or API key in config.

capabilities.name: Git diff blast radius
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing separate workflow: changed hunkâ†’containing symbolsâ†’incoming closure, base merge-base, deleted symbols, area classification and exact evidence quotes.

capabilities.name: Owner suggestions / reports
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing git-history ownership and text/markdown/Mermaid/JSON/HTML impact reports; optional cached model area names. Host-selected Git; never execute project hooks/config.

capabilities.name: Decision/preferences learning files
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Partial: Yoke immutable source-bound hypotheses/confirmed/dead-end/correction/rule and recall exist. Missing committed Markdown repo decisions, personal preferences/standing records, authors/date/touches/cost attribution and explicit import/export. Application knowledge must remain separate from central AgentMemory backend.

capabilities.name: Skill takeaway lifecycle
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing hidden but implemented commands: learn; skills list/show/confirm/fold/publish. Structured current-version history and human confirmation are useful; never treat records as execution authority.

capabilities.name: Local decision check
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing deterministic changed-value/ruled-out-approach/follows checks with quoted diff/note evidence; result is bounded heuristic analysis, not universal semantic intent verification. Server-only approved brain rules are absent from open source.

capabilities.name: Team overlap report
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing cached recent pushed-branch changed-file overlaps, unmerged note reads and local team/week report. Fetch must remain separately authorized; current refs read-only can work offline.

capabilities.name: Session cold-start mining
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing explicit user-owned transcript import/mining flow; upstream invokes installed Claude/model under user's login. Do not inspect unrelated transcripts or assume consent from indexing.

capabilities.name: Agent installation / removal
capabilities.upstreamSourcePaths: hosts/registry.ts, plan.ts, init.ts, retract.ts, config-write.ts; claude/init.ts
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing reversible dry-run managed-block installation, conflict-safe config merges and uninstall manifests. Source supports AGENTS, AdaL, Cursor, Gemini, Grok, Hermes, Antigravity, Copilot, Kiro, Windsurf plus Claude; Codex integration writes outside repo only when selected.

capabilities.name: Prompt/edit/session hooks and statusline
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing real host hooks for source context, post-edit blast, lazy background map update, one-session learning reminder, team overlap and stats. Implement explicit installation, no default code/model execution.

capabilities.name: Offline viewer
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Present native offline graph HTML, direction/uncertainty/source escaping. Partial UI parity: code/context/outline tabs, verb chips and live rebuild reload need explicit product decision and actual browser evidence.

capabilities.name: Self-hosted GitHub App
capabilities.upstreamSourcePaths: app/server.ts, identity.ts, queue.ts, review*.ts, pages.ts; docs/github-app.md
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing open-source workflow: HMAC webhookâ†’deduplicated/superseding bounded PR review workerâ†’update comment/capability page, health queue, optional disk-backed page lifecycle, no fork source execution. Current docs have stale persistence limitations; inspect actual pages.ts. No authorized deployment/message needed for development.

capabilities.name: History digest / brain onboarding
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing GitHub installation authorization/access check and bounded commit/closed-PR discussion/exported-symbol digest. Optional source-scrubbed handoff to own service. Hosted brain engine/API not in this repository.

capabilities.name: Cloud workspace/client/team UI
capabilities.upstreamSourcePaths: cloud/workspace.ts, workspace-sync.ts, diff.ts, nudge.ts; cli.ts login/workspace/team
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Missing own hosted workspace lifecycle/team aggregation/activity sync. Open-source client exposes connect/claim/me/repos/learnings/activity/team; actual proprietary service implementation/approved rule engine cannot be audited here. README 'soon' contradicts client presence; report client as inspectable, service as external.

capabilities.name: Updater/anonymous telemetry
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Absent by deliberate current design. Optional own update-check/package verification can replace convenience. Telemetry is not necessary for code intelligence; do not imitate upstream background egress without opt-in.

capabilities.name: Claimed savings and issue success
capabilities.baseline05Boundary: Not a feature implementation or transferable result. Need exact paired model/tool/runtime task campaign, independent correctness checks and full accounting; cannot promise 46% tool calls/42%tokens/60%time merely from implementation.
